answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and evaluates an epoch polynomial while deriving a rate-limiting nullifier under a Semaphore membership proof. Each message carries a polynomial-identity commitment; duplicate use of the same quota releases Shamir shares that reconstruct the agent’s private key, authorizing instantaneous on-chain collateral slashing. The plume, trellis, and forge layers bind membership, messages, and penalties while preserving honest agents’ anonymity.
